digest.component_or_area: Jira DC reconciler live verification harness
propositions: The epic's bidirectional reconciliation AC is unmet because CI ran the reconciler against an empty Jira instance, so a converged pass proved nothing moves.

Live verification must run against a copy of the project's real ticket store, obtained by fetching the gitignored orphan tickets branch and extracting into .tickets-tracker/ in a fresh git-init repo with no remotes.
Isolation must be asserted (git remote returns nothing, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials) rather than assumed, and sync.remote must not be asserted since it defaults to origin.

The store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* bindings and snapshot artifacts by enumerating the tree with a glob, since production bindings survive in a .bak-retarget backup and drive spurious deletions.

Each of fourteen inbound and fourteen outbound DC mutations must round-trip and be asserted individually against a named oracle, except set_parent's epic case which raises NotImplementedError asserted directly against the transport.

--filter-local-ids failed to match inbound creates because the create's target is the Jira key while a binding does not yet exist, fixed by passing both identifiers; the outbound edit cell still fails with 'ticket system not initialized' at the local edit.
